title: Issue Tracking with bd
content: IMPORTANT: This project uses bd (beads) for ALL issue tracking. Do NOT use markdown TODOs, task lists, or other tracking methods.

title: Why bd?
benefits: Dependency-aware: Track blockers and relationships between issues
Git-friendly: Auto-syncs to JSONL for version control
Agent-optimized: JSON output, ready work detection, discovered-from links
Prevents duplicate tracking systems and confusion

title: bd Quick Start
commands: bd ready # Check for ready work
bd create "Issue title" -t bug|feature|task -p 0-4 # Create new issue
bd create "Issue title" -p 1 --deps discovered-from:bd-123 # Create with dependency
bd create "Subtask" --parent <epic-id> # Hierarchical subtask (gets ID like epic-id.1)

title: AI Agent Workflow
steps: 1. Check ready work: bd ready shows unblocked issues
2. Claim your task: bd update <id> --status in_progress
3. Work on it: Implement, test, document
4. Discover new work? Create linked issue: bd create "Found bug" -p 1 --deps discovered-from:<parent-id>
6. Commit together: Always commit .beads/issues.jsonl with code changes

title: bv Overview
content: Graph-aware triage engine for Beads projects. Use robot flags for deterministic, dependency-aware outputs with precomputed metrics (PageRank, betweenness, critical path, cycles, HITS, eigenvector, k-core). CRITICAL: Use ONLY --robot-* flags. Bare bv launches interactive TUI that blocks your session.

title: bv Entry Point
content: bv --robot-triage is the single entry point. Returns: quick_ref, recommendations, quick_wins, blockers_to_clear, project_health, commands

title: bv Commands
graph: --robot-insights # Full metrics: PageRank, betweenness, HITS, eigenvector, cycles, k-core

title: bv Output
content: All robot JSON includes: data_hash (fingerprint), status (computed|approx|timeout|skipped), as_of/as_of_commit. Phase 1 (instant): degree, topo sort, density. Phase 2 (async 500ms): PageRank, betweenness, HITS, eigenvector, cycles. For >500 nodes, some metrics may be approximated.

title: zjj Workspace Isolation
content: Isolated Jujutsu workspaces with Zellij session integration. Use for parallel development, feature branches, experimental work.

title: jj Version Control
content: Jujutsu: compatible VCS like Git but better UX for stacked changes and workspace isolation.
commands: jj init # Initialize in Git repo

title: Important Rules
rules: Use bd for ALL task tracking
Link discovered work with discovered-from dependencies
Check bd ready before asking what to work on
Do NOT create markdown TODO lists
Do NOT use external issue trackers

title: CLI Commands
commands: intent check <spec.cue> --target <url> # Run spec against target

title: Landing the Plane (Session Completion)
content: When ending a work session, you MUST complete ALL steps. Work is NOT complete until git push succeeds.
workflow: 3. Update issue status (close finished, update in-progress)
4. PUSH TO REMOTE (MANDATORY): git pull --rebase && bd sync && git push
7. Hand off (provide context for next session)

title: Critical Rules
rules: Work is NOT complete until git push succeeds
NEVER stop before pushing - leaves work stranded locally
NEVER say ready to push when you are - YOU must push
If push fails, resolve and retry until it succeeds
